title: ResoLUT: Distilling Residual Networks into Lookup-Table Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.22955v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Logic networks built from Boolean gates or lookup tables (LUTs) promise efficient hardware inference, but training them at depth and learning their connectivity remain difficult. We do not train logic as logic. Instead, ResoLUT distills a trained residual network (ResNet) layer by layer into LUT trees, preserving its multi-bit residual stream and BatchNorm while extracting connectivity from the teacher rather than learning it. To our knowledge, ResoLUT is the first convolutional logic network in computer vision to retain a ResNet-style multi-bit residual stream. Hard LUT decisions are used throughout training and inference, avoiding a discretization gap in the logic. ResoLUT-20 reaches 95.66% on CIFAR-10 with twice the trees, and ResoLUT-56 reaches 78.87% on CIFAR-100 and 53.69% on ImageNet at 64px, the best results of logic and lookup-table networks on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, showing that LUT networks can scale in depth. translated_title: ResoLUT：将残差网络蒸馏为查找表网络
translated_abstract: 由布尔门或查找表构建的逻辑网络有望实现高效的硬件推理，但在深度训练以及学习其连接性方面仍然十分困难。我们并不直接将逻辑作为逻辑来训练，而是让 ResoLUT 将训练好的残差网络逐层蒸馏为 LUT 树，同时保留其多比特残差流和 BatchNorm，并从教师网络中提取连接性而非自行学习。据我们所知，ResoLUT 是计算机视觉领域首个保留 ResNet 风格多比特残差流的卷积逻辑网络。训练和推理全程均采用硬性的 LUT 决策，从而避免了逻辑中的离散化鸿沟。ResoLUT-20 在两倍树数量的情况下于 CIFAR-10 上达到 95.66% 的准确率，ResoLUT-56 在 CIFAR-100 上达到 78.87%，在 64px 分辨率的 ImageNet 上达到 53.69%，这是逻辑网络和查找表网络在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 上的最佳结果，表明 LUT 网络可以在深度上扩展。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ResoLUT 通过将训练好的 ResNet 逐层蒸馏为查找表树并保留其多比特残差流，实现了逻辑/查找表网络在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 上的最佳准确率，证明 LUT 网络可以随深度扩展。
en_tdlr: ResoLUT distills trained ResNets layer-by-layer into lookup-table trees while preserving the multi-bit residual stream, achieving the best accuracy of logic/LUT networks on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet, and demonstrating that LUT networks can scale in depth.
